description: Assess adoption-lifecycle stage, plan the chasm crossing, and build a beachhead strategy using Geoffrey Moore's Crossing the Chasm framework during PRD v1.0 Market Adoption. Triggers on requests to assess adoption stage, plan beachhead, cross the chasm, scale from early adopters, or when user asks "are we in the chasm?", "crossing the chasm", "beachhead strategy", "Moore", "whole product", "pragmatist buyers", "from early adopters to early majority".
